reason: Rossini Energy lets each site/operator activate payment and define its own tariffs. Exact guest pricing is surfaced through the QR/charge.re flow, but no deterministic public mapping from PAN EVSE IDs to the corresponding QR payment URL or anonymous station-price API was found. The public map is JavaScript-only and exposes no reusable exact tariff payload in the accessible surface. Generic examples such as 0.60 EUR/kWh are not used.
